title: Give retirement village inquiry and disclosure documents
what: Give prospective residents a general inquiry document within 14 days and a disclosure statement on request, and enter into a village contract no earlier than 14 days after giving the disclosure statement.

sources.title: Retirement Villages Act 1999 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The operator of a retirement village must provide a person with a general inquiry document within 14 days after becoming aware that the person is a prospective resident or is acting on behalf of a prospective resident

sources.title: Retirement Villages Act 1999 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The operator of a retirement village must not enter into a village contract with a person earlier than 14 days after the person (or another person acting on behalf of that person) has been provided with a disclosure statement by the operator

administration.who: NSW Department of Customer Service (the Secretary)

sources.title: Retirement Villages Act 1999 (NSW)

sources.quote: The Secretary may approve the content and form of information that the operator of a retirement village must provide to a prospective resident of the retirement village.
